nom: Differin Face Scrub Daily Brightening Exfoliator

segments.oily: One reviewer with sensitive, oily skin and acne rosacea says the scrub worked surprisingly well for her, despite low expectations given her skin type.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with oily, rosacea-prone skin, report no irritation and say the scrub is gentle enough for regular use, with one specifically noting it is scent-free for sensitive users.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it exfoliates without drying out their skin, striking a balance between exfoliating and moisturizing; one reviewer cautions that using it more than once daily or every other day may dry out skin and recommends following with a good moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with acne rosacea says the scrub worked well for her skin; by contrast, one dissenting review reports red splotches appearing after each of two uses, with a burning sensation when a serum was applied afterward.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers say their skin tone looks brighter and more even with regular use; one dissenting review says she hasn't seen changes in her dark spots yet, though she notes she uses other products that might be counteracting the effect.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts and clearer, blackhead-free skin when used a couple of times a week rather than daily; one switching for hormonal acne says it did not cause a severe breakout during the transition.

aspects.libelle: Some bottles arrive oxidized or off-smelling
Great value, a little goes a long way
Fine beads feel weak, barely exfoliate
Creamy texture, not harsh or abrasive

extraits.titre: If you want your face to feel like it’s on fire, use this!
extraits.texte: I was really excited to try the Brightening Exfoliating Scrub because I like the Differin Gel so much. It was horrible. I honestly want my money back. It felt fine when it was on, but my face had red splotches afterwards. Thought maybe it was a first-time fluke. Second time, same thing happened. Then I put some face serum on, and it felt like my face was on fire. I tried so hard to wipe my face off with water and ice cubes, but it burned for a long while after. Also, a lot of differin products contain alcohols, parabens, and sulfates…come up with some less crappy ingredients to use.

Like I said, in the video Differin does make some really good products, but this is NOT one of them. This is complete fail. I would not EVER RECOMMEND buyers purchase this product. It exfoliates nothing the consistency of the beads if any at all (LOL) is not there it’s very mentholated, so I guess it’s more of a mask than exfoliator. But yeah it’s not worth your hard earned money. If I could give it zero stars I would but I guess with this rating system they at least get one in every category.

My doctor suggested I switch to the Differin skincare line due to hormonal acne and melasma. Unfortunately I did not realize the exfoliating agent for this face wash are tiny blue pieces of micro plastic. The face wash is gentle but cleansing and does not have an offensive scent but such a bummer that tiny pieces of plastics are exfoliating / penetrating your skin and then washing down your drain. This cleanser didn’t cause me to severely break out from the change but definitely will NOT purchase again unless manufacturer changes the exfoliant agent. Such a bummer because I do like the cleanser but can’t get past the fact these pieces of plastic are literally leaving my shower to leech into the ground water. 👎🏼

extraits.titre: Gentle Yet Effective Exfoliation for Clearer Skin!
extraits.texte: I have acne-prone skin, so finding an exfoliator that’s both effective and gentle has been a challenge, until I tried the Differin Daily Brightening Exfoliator. The formula is mild enough for daily use but still does an amazing job at smoothing my skin and improving its overall tone and texture. The scrub has a creamy consistency with fine exfoliating beads that don’t feel harsh or irritating. After using it for a couple of weeks, I’ve noticed my skin looking brighter and more even, with fewer breakouts. It doesn’t dry out my skin either, which is a huge plus. If you’re looking for a daily exfoliator that won’t aggravate acne, this is a great option!

I tried this product out of curiosity since I was looking for a new cleanser. For context, I have sensitive, oily skin and also acne rosacea, so I did not have too much hope that this would work. Despite my worries, this product worked insanely well. I love the cooling effect it has but make sure to wet your face before. This product is definitely one of my favorites from differin and I totally recommend buying if you have the same skin type as me!!

extraits.titre: Great to use in between products!
extraits.texte: I alternate this and another differin daily face wash without exfoliation in it. I use this once/twice a week when I can feel a lot of black heads on my forehead and use the other the rest of the time. Using this routine helps keep my skin very clear and blackhead free. I wouldn't recommend using it everyday as exfoliating everyday does more harm than good. Love this product and the way it makes my skin feel.

extraits.titre: Love how clean my skin feels!
extraits.texte: I have been using this product for several months but just recently purchased through Amazon. The Brightening Exfoliator leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed with no irritation. I recommend using only once per day or every other day (I use it nightly) as it may dry out skin. Definitely use a good moisturizer after. My skin tone and texture is brighter and more even when I use it regularly.

reserve: Only 13 reviews were available for this product, so segment and concern coverage is thinner than usual and some conclusions rest on a single review.
